g.text: General purpose drivers (sol. 25-28): IRLR3110Z DPAK, latch U2 output HIGH = ON, clocked by /SOL 1 (J113-12). S3M tie-back diode cathodes are brought out

g.desc: General purpose drivers (sol. 25-28): IRLR3110Z DPAK, latch U2 output HIGH = ON, clocked by /SOL 1 (J113-12). S3M tie-back diode cathodes are brought out

g.text: to J122 pins 5,6,8,9 so the harness can tie them to the supply actually used (+50V coil or +20V flasher).

g.text: Outputs J122 (playfield, key pin 7), J123 (backbox, key pin 2) and J124 (cabinet, key pin 4) as on the A-12697. U2 bits 4-7 unused.
